newsitem.title: UK: Centrica welcomes Ofgas discounts decision.
newsitem.headline: Centrica welcomes Ofgas discounts decision.

text.p: Centrica Plc's British Gas Trading on Wednesday welcomed the decision by the gas regulator Ofgas to allow it to offer discounts to customers in the south-west of England.
"This is good news for customers who have chosen ValuePlus and is an important step in the development of the competitive market," managing director Mike Alexander said in a statement.

Centrica launched the ValuePlus scheme in March to customers in the region, giving those paying by direct debit a discount averaging five percent, to dissuade them from switching to rival gas suppliers.

Ofwat, which said that the decision should not be seen as a precedent, wants to change the company's licence so that three months notice has to be given of any price changes to "ensure that predatory or pre-emptive price cutting does not occur".
